package handlers

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/usecase/practiceroute"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
)

func TestPracticeReadinessHandlerBindsRouteAndStepAndRejectsUnknownFields(t *testing.T) {
	const routeID = "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777"
	const stepID = "checkpoint-one"
	input := domain.PracticeLearningReadinessRequestV1{Schema: domain.PracticeLearningReadinessRequestSchemaV1,
		TaskInstanceID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", StudentID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
		TaskRevisionID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", TaskRevisionDigest: "sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa",
		RouteID: routeID, RouteDigest: "sha256:bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb", StepID: stepID}
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(input)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	handler := PracticeLearningHandler{Routes: practiceroute.Resolver{}}

	request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/", bytes.NewReader(encoded))
	routeContext := chi.NewRouteContext()
	routeContext.URLParams.Add("routeID", routeID)
	routeContext.URLParams.Add("stepID", "different-step")
	request = request.WithContext(context.WithValue(request.Context(), chi.RouteCtxKey, routeContext))
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()
	handler.ReconcileReadiness(response, request)
	if response.Code != http.StatusConflict {
		t.Fatalf("path/body identity mismatch status = %d, body=%s", response.Code, response.Body.String())
	}

	withUnknown := append(bytes.TrimSuffix(encoded, []byte("}")), []byte(`,"decision":"READY"}`)...)
	request = httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/", bytes.NewReader(withUnknown))
	response = httptest.NewRecorder()
	handler.ReconcileReadiness(response, request)
	if response.Code != http.StatusUnprocessableEntity {
		t.Fatalf("unknown readiness field status = %d, body=%s", response.Code, response.Body.String())
	}
}
